causalDistinctness: Cross-sectional divergence between 24h price return and 24h open-interest change. Distinct from funding, basis, price-volume, top-trader positioning, trend, reversal, seasonality and breakout families already opened.

externalHypothesisEvidence.formula: alpha = previous return - previous open-interest percentage change
externalHypothesisEvidence.sourceSign: continuation in alpha: long high alpha, short low alpha
externalHypothesisEvidence.evidenceRole: hypothesis generation only; not MarketsGPT validation

dataAuthority.metrics: Binance official data.binance.vision USD-M daily metrics archives
dataAuthority.price: Binance official data.binance.vision USD-M monthly 1d klines
dataAuthority.currentOiSnapshot: latest metrics snapshot strictly before decision, age <=15 minutes
dataAuthority.previousOiSnapshot: latest metrics snapshot strictly before decision-24h, age <=15 minutes
dataAuthority.liquidity: prior 30 completed UTC days mean quoteAssetVolume >= 5,000,000 USD

cohort.selectionRule: first 24 current-active Binance Spot-USDT + USD-M perpetual symbols after the V20 contamination union, ordered by onboarding date, excluding multiplier/stable/commodity-backed contracts and ARP22 outcomes.

portfolio.ranking: ascending signal with lexical symbol tie-break to assign ranks 1..N; highest signal receives highest rank

costs.chargedOn: sum absolute portfolio weight changes plus terminal liquidation

failureRule: Any development gate failure closes ARP23-OID1. No sign flip, lag sweep, holding-period rescue, universe trimming or threshold relaxation is allowed after outcome opening. Validation and holdout remain sealed unless the unchanged development gate passes.
